newOpenItem.title: Checkpoint mechanism steps and functional limits

review.rationale: The pembrolizumab entry is corrected at its authoritative depth owner. The shared PD1_STEPS template still asserts restored function, killing and persistent memory for other entries. Audit the actual users, targets, label mechanisms and functional limits individually; no class-wide source or clinical approval is inferred from one product label.

sourceOnlyItems.finding: The postoperative treatment node says extra medicine if cancer remains. The canonical timing and residual-disease notes qualify this by prior care and trial eligibility; the source diagram owner should qualify its label.
